SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_PAYMENTCARD_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CARD_NBR ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
     SELECT
     BCC.CARD_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME1
    ,BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN
    ,BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE
    ,BCC.CARD_PDT_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_BANK_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_SHORT_NAME
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL
    ,BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_REQ1
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME2
    ,BCC.CARD_SEQ_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_FORMAT_ID
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT
    ,BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE
    ,BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE
    ,BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARFP BCC WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION

      SELECT
     BCC.CARD_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME1
    ,BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN
    ,BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE
    ,BCC.CARD_PDT_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_BANK_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_SHORT_NAME
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL
    ,BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_REQ1
    ,BCC.CARD_EMB_NAME2
    ,BCC.CARD_SEQ_NBR
    ,BCC.CARD_FORMAT_ID
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT
    ,BCC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT
    ,BCC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE
    ,BCC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE
    ,BCC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP BCC WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'

)A)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard WHERE RN =1;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
     CARD_NBR
    ,CARD_EMB_NAME1
    ,CARD_DTE_OPEN
    ,CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE
    ,CARD_PDT_NBR
    ,CARD_BANK_NBR
    ,CARD_SHORT_NAME
    ,CARD_SUP_REL
    ,CARD_DTE_CLOSE
    ,CARD_EMB_REQ1
    ,CARD_EMB_NAME2
    ,CARD_SEQ_NBR
    ,CARD_FORMAT_ID
    ,convert(numeric,CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT)
    ,convert(numeric,CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT)
    ,CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE
    ,CARD_MEMBER_SINCE
    ,CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE
    ,BNK_CODE
)) HASHROW, CARD_NBR, CARD_DTE_OPEN,CARD_PDT_NBR,BNK_CODE
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard 
)

,

TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT
AS
(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5' ,CONCAT(
     PaymentCardId
    ,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
    ,PaymentCardIssuedDate
    ,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
    ,PaymentCardTypeId
    ,BankNumber                                                         
    ,PaymentCardShortName
    ,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
    ,PaymentCardClosedDate
    ,EmbossingDate
    ,PaymentCardGroup
    ,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
    ,PaymentCardFormatId
    ,convert(numeric,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit)
    ,convert(numeric,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit)
    ,PaymentCardLastActivationDate
    ,MemberSinceDate
    ,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
    ,FinancialInstitutionId                                             
    )) HASHROW, PaymentCardId, PaymentCardIssuedDate,PaymentCardTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BNKM.PaymentCard
    )

,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT 
        SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
        ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
        ,ISNULL(SRC.CARD_NBR, TGT.PaymentCardId) AS PaymentCardId
        ,ISNULL(SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN, TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate) AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
        ,ISNULL(SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR, TGT.PaymentCardTypeId) AS PaymentCardTypeId
        ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CARD_NBR = TGT.PaymentCardId 
    AND SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
    AND SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
    AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
 [PaymentCardId] = SRC.CARD_NBR
,[PaymentCardToken] = NULL
,[MaskedPaymentAccountNumber] = NULL
,[EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName] = SRC.CARD_EMB_NAME1
,[PaymentCardIssuedDate] = SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN
,[PaymentCardActivationTimestamp] = SRC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE
,[PaymentCardTypeId] = SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR
,[DebitCardIndicator] = NULL
,[PaymentCardNote] = NULL
,[BankNumber] = SRC.CARD_BANK_NBR
,[PaymentCardShortName] = SRC.CARD_SHORT_NAME
,[PaymentCardHolderTypeId] = SRC.CARD_SUP_REL
,[PaymentCardClosedDate] = SRC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE
,[EmbossingDate] = SRC.CARD_EMB_REQ1
,[PaymentCardGroup] = SRC.CARD_EMB_NAME2
,[PaymentCardSequenceNumber] = SRC.CARD_SEQ_NBR
,[PaymentCardFormatId] = SRC.CARD_FORMAT_ID
,[SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit] = SRC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT
,[SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit] = SRC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT
,[PaymentCardLastActivationDate] = SRC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE
,[MemberSinceDate] = SRC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE
,[PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp] = SRC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BNK_CODE
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE] = 'CCD'
,[WORKFLOWID] = 0
,[TASKRUNID] = 0
,[INSERTDTTM] = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.PaymentCard TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId 
    AND DELTA.PaymentCardIssuedDate = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
    AND DELTA.PaymentCardTypeId = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC ON SRC.CARD_NBR = TGT.PaymentCardId
    AND SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN = TGT.PaymentCardIssuedDate
    AND SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR = TGT.PaymentCardTypeId
    AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'	
;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCard
(
 PaymentCardId
,PaymentCardToken
,MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
,EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
,PaymentCardIssuedDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,PaymentCardTypeId
,DebitCardIndicator
,PaymentCardNote
,BankNumber
,PaymentCardShortName
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardClosedDate
,EmbossingDate
,PaymentCardGroup
,PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,PaymentCardFormatId
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
,SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
,PaymentCardLastActivationDate
,MemberSinceDate
,PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CARD_NBR as PaymentCardId
, NULL AS PaymentCardToken
,NULL AS MaskedPaymentAccountNumber
,SRC.CARD_EMB_NAME1 AS EmbossedPaymentCardCardholderName
,SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
,SRC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR PaymentCardTypeId
,NULL AS DebitCardIndicator
,NULL AS PaymentCardNote
,SRC.CARD_BANK_NBR AS BankNumber
,SRC.CARD_SHORT_NAME AS PaymentCardShortName
,SRC.CARD_SUP_REL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,SRC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE AS PaymentCardClosedDate
,SRC.CARD_EMB_REQ1 AS EmbossingDate
,SRC.CARD_EMB_NAME2 AS PaymentCardGroup
,SRC.CARD_SEQ_NBR AS PaymentCardSequenceNumber
,SRC.CARD_FORMAT_ID AS PaymentCardFormatId
,SRC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCreditLimit
,SRC.CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT AS SupplementaryCardPermanentCashLimit
,SRC.CARD_LST_DATE_ACTIVE AS PaymentCardLastActivationDate
,SRC.CARD_MEMBER_SINCE AS MemberSinceDate
,SRC.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE AS PaymentCardLastRenewedTimestamp
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'CCD' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCard_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.PaymentCardId = SRC.CARD_NBR 
    AND DELTA.PaymentCardIssuedDate = SRC.CARD_DTE_OPEN
    AND DELTA.PaymentCardTypeId = SRC.CARD_PDT_NBR
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
Where Record_status in ('INSERT');

END
GO
